resources.string: Tap to pick a photo from your phone
Photo scanning needs internet. You can still log manually.
Menosan suggests the item details from your photo. AI suggestions can be wrong, so you\'ll check them before saving. Your photo isn\'t stored.
One kind of item per photo, in good light, works best. You can crop out the background next.
Drag the corners so the box covers just the waste. Leave out the background.
Your photo. The box shows the part that will be analyzed.
Working out what\'s in it so you can log it faster.
This is taking a little longer. The server may be waking up, which can take up to a minute.
Photo scanning needs internet. Check your connection and try again, or log this item manually.
Try cropping closer around the item, or take a closer photo. You can always log it manually.
This happens sometimes. Try again, or use a clearer photo. You can always log it manually.
Try a different photo, or log the item manually.
You can scan again tomorrow. Logging manually works anytime.
You can scan again on %1$s. Logging manually works anytime.
Try a different photo, or log the item manually.
Check your connection and try again. If this keeps happening, log out and log in again from Profile.
Choose a different photo (JPEG or PNG works best), or log the item manually.
You can choose a photo from your gallery instead, or log the item manually.
Try again in a moment, or log the item manually.
Fields marked \"AI suggestion\" came from your photo. Edit them, or tap the chip to keep a value as is.
Check the details and tick the box to save.
Entry saved. Thanks for checking the details!
